sources.title: Jeeves. Reasoning improves Jev-like decision models - GitHub
sources.snippet: Jev-like models give calibrated decision probabilities, but at low accuracy. A lot of pipelines therefore rely on a reasoning model as a fallback. Jeeves trains a Jev-like Qwen3.5-9B (LoRA and a pointer head) using CISPO to reason before it decides. This results in better performance on out of domain tasks, and outperforms Jev in JevBench hard (public).
